value.rationale: The primary source leaves a natural, physically measurable amplitude b_infty(beta) undetermined despite identifying a sharp shift from exact dual mixing at zero drift to singular dual quasi-mixing at every nonzero drift. The leading pi/beta height and 1/(beta^3 n^2) transfer normalizer are an exact singular dynamical invariant that quantifies the bridge between regimes; the explicit all-small-drift error bound is more than an isolated number or routine finite example. This is a sequential limit only, not an asserted joint crossover law.
